The signal displays an illuminated 'Walk' figure composed of LED dots, transitioning in color from red at the top (head/shoulders) to yellow in the middle and green at the bottom (legs). The housing is dark with a large, curved visor extending over the lens. The background is dark and indistinct, suggesting nighttime or shadow.

The elliptical shape of the lens rim and the curvature of the visor show minor inconsistencies in perspective geometry, appearing slightly warped rather than following a perfect optical curve.
